scope: Additive changes to the existing local game; no public deployment or billing changes.

checks: Original coastline values retained outside the authored gulf and in original land cells
Reachable plots, water sources, obsidian approaches and three boat landings
Atomic planting, tending, harvesting, donation, exchange and feast rewards
Invalid, obstructed, distant, full-inventory and incompatible actions rejected
Affiliation independent of species; local expedition shortcut rejected
Socket-level obsidian gathering rejects client-authored reward counts
Save/import migration, reconnect and elapsed crop growth
Default five-player limit and eight-player core share the same 48 plots

assets.recordScope: The reused delivery verifier also records the pre-existing adventure's 66 landmarks and 48 scenery placements; those are not gulf placement counts.

browser.runtime: Bundled Playwright controlling real headless Chrome with D3D11
normalUiFlows: Enter gulf, collect welcome supplies, walk to a plot, plant, fetch water, return and tend, harvest, reload and resume
Walk to Pale Ridge and obsidian outcrops, join the country, gather obsidian, return on foot and exchange
Craft and board a boat, select the eastern shore on the map, travel about 318 metres, disembark onto land, walk to Reed Shore and join
Donate all three supplies, complete a gathering and claim the feast
Reload final source and open the local contribution panel with key 3
explicitFixtures: The isolated QA server clock advanced 240 seconds for crop ripening; movement ran in real time.
Boat verification started at the western beach with 12 wood supplied by the QA helper; subsequent crafting, sailing and landing used the ordinary UI.
Feast verification supplied 8 wood, 12 berries and 4 obsidian and positioned the character at Many Hearths; all donation and reward actions used the ordinary UI.

localRollout.notes: Port 3000 was not running. Started node server.mjs in a hidden process, then verified a fresh Chrome session, gulf entry and welcome supplies in a dedicated QA room. No previous checkpoint was applied. The isolated QA server on 3110 was closed.

limitations: No physical smartphone, large-player-count load, long-duration soak or constant 60 FPS verification.
Local Node restart persistence is unchanged; the existing save/export path and short reconnect restoration include the new state.
Countries, farming, accelerated crops, the gulf and coexistence of different-era characters are deliberate fiction.
Regional fishing and craft traditions are lore, not new fishing or political simulation.
